relationships.subject: Tuina
relationships.evidence_quote: Tuina therapy reduced the activation level of pain-related brain regions and inhibited the decreased activity of the motor cortex caused by nerve injury

key_findings: Tuina after sciatic nerve transection and repair improved sensory and motor recovery in rats.
Tuina lowered fMRI activation in somatosensory, limbic, pain-regulating areas and basal ganglia, and preserved motor cortex activity.
